description: Zonas de aparcamiento en les Preses is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lespreses.cat. Parking areas in les Preses is a set of cartographic data that shows an interactive map viewer with the name and location point of the five parking areas available in the municipality of Les Preses. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Parking areas in les Preses" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Aparcamiento, Les Preses, Aparcament, Parking. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
